_comment: User allowlist for known-good software. KNOWN-BAD ALWAYS OVERRIDES: a Defender hit / known-implant hash / IOC procname re-scores normally even if a rule below matches, so you can never hide real malware here. Keep it TIGHT -- never allowlist a broad directory (e.g. all of AppData or Temp) or you blind the detector. Rule types: 'path_globs' = fnmatch over exe/image_path (case-insensitive, use \\ in JSON); 'signers' = case-insensitive substring of the Authenticode signer subject (e.g. your code-signing org); 'sha256' = exact file hash (also tested against md5); 'entity_keys' = exact namespaced key from a finding. Add your own software by appending to the matching array.
